nodes.text: Of late I've noticed that, both China & Congo has become an experimental grounds of strange diseases/viruses for reasons known best by the slanderers. The booming economy of China is giving some developing nations sleepless nights. Therefore, ignore all negative things being said

nodes.text: ....some nation(s). Since the day China enhanced a good trade relationship with other nations, some nations are working hard to paint a bad picture on China through disinformation in order to dilute China's flourishing business relationship with other countries.
